summary.intent: Execute Phase 22 (performance baselines completion), clean up code quality, populate staging baselines via Playwright, push PR, resolve all review comments, merge main, and plan Phases 24-26 as gap closure phases.
summary.outcome: Phase 22 fully executed and verified (3/3 plans, 9/9 must-haves), PR #355 created and all 16 review thread comments resolved across 4 rounds, staging DB reset to fix schema mismatch, journey timing baselines populated from live staging, and Phases 24-26 scaffolded on a docs branch.

repo: Phase 20 vault migration deleted incremental migrations and assumed staging DB would be reset — it wasn't, causing NOT NULL constraint violations on removed columns when new wallet accounts tried to initialize vaults on staging.
IPNS per-folder keypairs are derived from owner's vault key via HKDF — this is the root technical blocker for writable shares (single-writer model, no proxy signing).
GSD state can show a phase as 'next' even when it's already marked [x] in ROADMAP.md — the phase complete tool uses the roadmap's next incomplete pointer, not disk verification.
Performance marks follow the pattern `cipherbox:{module}:{operation}:{invocation-id}:{start|end}` — the invocation ID prevents collision when the same operation runs concurrently.
BYO pinning path (`pinFn` override) bypasses the `addToIpfs` instrumentation — required a separate `withPerf('ipfs:upload:byo', ...)` wrapper in `upload/index.ts` to capture those timings.
Playwright wallet injection via `page.addInitScript` (mock wallet EIP-1193) only works through the Playwright test runner, not MCP browser sessions.
Phase branches use `feat/phase-{N}-{slug}` convention; worktrees should be created after phase docs are committed to the target branch, not before.

code.finding: PERF_ENABLED check must guard `typeof process !== 'undefined'` AND `typeof process.env?.NODE_ENV === 'string'` to avoid the process polyfill evaluating to true in browser production builds.
Concurrent withPerf calls for the same operation name collide on mark names — fixed by adding a module-level counter appended to each mark/measure name.
PerformanceMeasure entries must be cleared after creation via performance.clearMeasures() to prevent unbounded accumulation in long-lived sessions.
BYO pinFn code path added withPerf('ipfs:upload:byo') wrapper; CipherBox path in ipfs/index.ts uses 'ipfs:upload:cipherbox' — allows distinguishing provider paths in perf timelines.
404 check for IPNS resolution was missing error.response.status — needed AxiosError-compatible status check alongside the response status.
Silent skip on missing metric in checkThresholds is intentional — the function is designed to be permissive when a scenario doesn't exercise all metric keys.
Login flow duplication across journey tests is intentional — each journey needs sub-phase timing capture from its own auth start, not a shared session.
globalThis extension for Performance API mock requires 'declare global' block rather than 'as any' cast to stay type-safe.

workflow: PR review comment resolution required 4 separate rounds (16 threads total) — automated reviewers (CodeRabbit, Copilot) post new comments after each push, so the resolve-pr-comments skill needs to be run iteratively after each fix commit.
Staging DB schema should be validated as part of phase completion when migrations are restructured — the NOT NULL violation was only caught when running actual Playwright tests against staging.
The GSD `phase complete` CLI tool marks the roadmap correctly but the `next_phase` pointer can return an already-completed phase if phases were completed out of order.
Background task notifications from executor subagents (task-notifications) can arrive after the phase is already fully complete — safe to ignore if spot-checks passed.
Git worktrees should be created from the correct base branch after doc commits are made, not as a preparatory step before content exists.

friction: Staging DB NOT NULL constraint caused confusing 500 errors during Playwright journey tests — root cause required SSH into staging and log inspection to identify.
GitHub Actions lint-pr-title workflow unexpectedly required manual approval — cause not identified (pure shell workflow, repo owner committer, no workflow file changes in PR).
GSD progress routing suggested Phase 23 as next after completing Phase 22, but Phase 23 was already completed — the tool used roadmap pointer rather than disk verification.
Multiple rounds of PR review resolution needed (4 rounds) because automated reviewers post new threads after each push — no way to batch-resolve proactively.
Stale worktree `cipher-box-phase-20` left over from a previous session required manual pruning.
Premature worktree creation for worker2 had to be reverted because phase docs hadn't been committed yet.
Usage limits interrupted the session mid-way through threshold test verification, requiring a continuation prompt.
open_items: Phase 24 (Bug Fixes & Test Infrastructure): fix bin IPNS 404 resolution bug, device registry format error, load test 401 token refresh, headless sdk-core load tests, vault v2 recovery E2E tests.
Phase 25 (Desktop Enhancements): desktop auto-update mechanism, desktop TEE file enrollment for new files added post-onboarding.
Phase 26 (Observability & UX Tuning): Grafana alerting thresholds from Phase 18/22 baselines, timeout tuning for sub-2s UX based on baseline data.
Journey timing login baseline shows 23.5s dominated by Web3Auth Core Kit MPC init — may warrant investigation or UX optimization (spinner, progressive loading).
GitHub Actions approval requirement cause is unknown — settings.General > fork PR workflow approval may have been reset by a GitHub platform update.
1 active debug session and 13 pending todos need review before completing milestone.
Milestone v1.1 complete — `/gsd:complete-milestone` should be run after Phases 24-26 are planned and the docs branch is merged.
Writable shares deferred long-term due to IPNS single-writer constraint — would require proxy signing or per-share IPNS keypair delegation to implement.
Web Worker large file encryption (>=10MB) remains deferred — blocks UI thread for power users.
Standalone CLI recovery tool deferred — current browser-based recovery.html has robustness limitations.
